title.en: Monthly temperature statistics, 10 km x 10 km,  1971-2000

description.en:
Monthly temperature statistics for 10x10 km grid, for 30 year period (1971 - 2000):

 * average of the 30 years month average temperatures
 * average of the 30 years month minimum temperatures
 * minimum of the 30 years month minimum temperatures
  * average of the 30 years month maximum temperatures
  * maximum of the 30 years month maximum temperatures

The statistics have been calculated based on daily values by Finnish Meteorological Intitute, the original dataset is described [here](https://urn.fi/urn:nbn:fi:csc-kata00001000000000000547). The statistics have been calculated by Eduardo Gonzalez from University of Helsinki. Finally the data has been transformed to Shape format by Kylli Ek from CSC.

The coordinates represent the grid center. 

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)
